descriptions.database_search: Search the Discogs database for releases, masters, artists, or labels — the main discovery endpoint. All parameters are optional: q (free text), type (release/master/artist/label), artist, label, genre, style, country, year, format, catno, barcode, plus per_page and page. Returns a paginated results array with each match's id, type, title, year, label, format, and thumbnail. Use this to find records matching a crate-digging brief; use releases_get or masters_get when you already have an id.
descriptions.collection_folders: List the folders in a user's Discogs collection. Required: username. Returns the folder array, each with id, name, and count; folder 0 is the special 'All' folder holding every record. Works without a token when the collection is public. Call this first to discover folder ids, then pass one to collection_releases.
descriptions.collection_releases: List the records inside one folder of a user's collection. Required: username, folder_id (use 0 for every record in the collection). Optional: sort, sort_order, per_page (max 100), page. Returns a paginated releases array with each record's release id, title, artists, year, labels, and formats. Works without a token when the collection is public.
descriptions.wantlist_get: List the records on a user's Discogs wantlist. Required: username. Optional: per_page (max 100), page. Returns a paginated wants array with each record's release id, title, artists, year, and the note and rating the user attached. Works without a token when the wantlist is public. Pair with marketplace_stats to price the wantlist.
descriptions.marketplace_stats: Get the current lowest asking price and the number of copies for sale for one release. Required: release_id. Optional: curr_abbr (currency, e.g. USD, GBP, EUR). Returns num_for_sale, lowest_price, and blocked_from_sale. Keyless — no token needed. Note this is the lowest price a seller is currently ASKING, not a sale price and not an appraisal; use marketplace_price-suggestions (token required) for condition-graded guidance.
